verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents the Client Credentials flow for machine-to-machine apps such as CLIs, daemons and backend services, where the application authenticates instead of a user. Apps present a Client ID and Client Secret and receive an Access Token, with scopes and granular permissions for M2M communication; Auth0 also pitches unique identities for AI agents. A community comment mentioning existing customer 'M2M setups' indirectly corroborates real-world use. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the M2M flow, and docs on credential rotation or agent-specific scoping in this pack.
